topic.label: Financial Regulation and AML
topic.desc: Financial Regulation and AML: Anti-Money Laundering, Compliance Programs and Reporting, Sanctions and Offshore Regimes, Securities Regulators and Rules and KYC and Beneficial Ownership.

concepts.label: Anti-Money Laundering
concepts.desc: AML programs, suspicious activity monitoring, SARs, placement, layering and integration.

concepts.label: KYC and Beneficial Ownership
concepts.desc: Know your customer, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence and beneficial ownership.

concepts.label: Compliance Programs and Reporting
concepts.desc: Policies, surveillance, regulatory reporting, recordkeeping and exams.

concepts.label: Sanctions and Offshore Regimes
concepts.desc: Sanctions lists, screening, offshore financial centers and onshore versus offshore compliance.

concepts.label: Securities Regulators and Rules
concepts.desc: SEC, FINRA, CFTC and foreign regulators, registration, disclosure and market conduct rules.

skills.label: AML Program Outline
skills.desc: Outlines the parts of an AML program for a firm type.

skills.label: AML Red Flag Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews a pattern of transactions for money laundering red flags and states each one.

skills.label: KYC Checklist Builder
skills.desc: Builds the KYC and CDD checklist for a customer type, including beneficial owners.

skills.label: Regulatory Report Calendar
skills.desc: Lists a firm's recurring regulatory filings with deadlines.

skills.label: Sanctions Screening Explainer
skills.desc: Explains how sanctions screening works and how a match is resolved.

skills.label: Regulator Mapper
skills.desc: Maps which regulator and rules apply to an activity and jurisdiction.
